reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #416 '[每日信息流] 2024-03-30' is an auto-generated daily news digest, not a code-change request. Its entire 39993-char body is a categorized list of external security-news links (Packet Storm, Reddit, blogs, etc.) with no defect, no feature request, and no reference to any repository file/symbol. Repository state proves the issue is machine-produced content: .github/workflows/daily.yml runs `gh issue create --title "[每日信息流] `date +'%Y-%m-%d'`" -F today.md --label "daily"`, and #416 carries exactly the 'daily' label with 0 comments. The admission 'funding' of 2500 EUR is a false positive scraped verbatim from a link TITLE inside the digest: '[[Account Take Over] through reset password token leaked in response, 2500 € Reward](https://infosecwriteups.com/...)', not a real pledge. Likewise the technical_signals broken/bug/bug_bounty/bugfixes/distributed/failures all come from news headlines and URL slugs ('Bug Bounty in InfoSec Write-ups', 'source=rss----7b722bfd1b8d--bug_bounty', '10,000 bugfixes in 10,000 days', 'Easterbug trickery'), not from this codebase. Classified as a documentation/content (marketing feed) deliverable with no concrete engineering change; blocked per the non-engineering rule. No product or branch edits were made; checkout left at upstream master.
